item.title: Army spokesperson: Strait of Hormuz will only be reopened by accepting Iran’s conditions
item.description: Bandar Abbas, IRNA – Iranian Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia, while emphasizing the complete dominance of the armed forces over the Strait of Hormuz, says that the reopening of this strategic waterway is only possible with the acceptance of the Islamic Republic of Iran’s conditions by the United States, and any renewed aggression by the enemy will be met with an immediate, crushing response that goes beyond the geographical borders of the region.

item.title: Araghchi stresses increasing the level of economic engagement with ECO member states
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in a meeting with his Pakistani counterpart, Ishaq Dar, while expressing appreciation for Pakistan’s gracious hospitality and the successful hosting of the 30th meeting of the Council of Ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO), emphasized the strengthening of multilateral cooperation, the enhancement of economic and commercial engagement, and the expansion of coordination among member states.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86323916/Araghchi-stresses-increasing-the-level-of-economic-engagement

Islamabad, IRNA — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in a meeting with his Pakistani counterpart, Ishaq Dar, while expressing appreciation for Pakistan’s gracious hospitality and the successful hosting of the 30th meeting of the Council of Ministers of the Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO), emphasized the strengthening of multilateral cooperation, the enhancement of economic and commercial engagement, and the expansion of coordination among member states.
